history.summary: A freehold 504sqft 1BR essentially on top of Pasir Panjang MRT (170m, Circle Line) in D05, near One-North/Mapletree Business City, at $1040k / $2063 psf. The 4.6% CAGR rests on only 13 transactions (low confidence), but freehold + doorstep-MRT + One-North-adjacent rental location is a strong combination for a shoebox.
history.rating_rationale: For a 1BR, the two things that matter most are MRT proximity and rental demand — this has 170m to Pasir Panjang MRT and sits beside the One-North/MBC employment cluster, an ideal small-unit rental location. Freehold at $2063 psf in D05, and the listing PSF appears well below the $2561 median (some of that gap is unit-mix, but the location quality is real). The 13-txn appreciation rate is the main caveat (low statistical confidence). Strong location + freehold tip it to a Buy at medium confidence.
red_flags: Only 13 URA transactions — appreciation rate low-confidence, boutique liquidity
PSF gap to $2561 median likely partly unit-mix, not pure discount
catalysts: Freehold tenure with 170m doorstep access to Pasir Panjang MRT (Circle Line)
Adjacent to One-North / Mapletree Business City / Science Park — deep professional tenant pool
Greater Southern Waterfront transformation in the D05 corridor
